## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Denpasar, Indonesia. It starts at Jl. Raya Tegallalang, Tegallalang, Kec. Tegallalang, Kabupaten Gianyar.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Get ready for an exciting adventure on a sunny island, where the Alas Harum Swing is eagerly waiting for you. This iconic swing, positioned on a mountain's edge, is a must-visit on any Bali trip. What better way to enjoy the astonishing Tegallalang Rice Terraces than from a bird's eye view?
>
> Your journey begins with a warm welcome from the friendly crew, who will quickly brief you on safety measures. Then, it's time to fly as you swing over the edge of a cliff.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €4.41. It was rated 3.0 out of 5 from 1 ratings. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
